title: Origination page lacks Content-Security-Policy meta and uses inline <script> — other pages have CSP
detail: Local build site/origination/index.html contains an inline <script> block (filter-btn click handler) and no <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">, while site/index.html, site/picks/index.html, site/unresolved/index.html, site/review/index.html, site/coverage/index.html, site/methodology/index.html each have exactly 1 CSP meta. The inline script is 'document.addEventListener(click) filter-btn toggle' in scripts/build_origination.py:435. This violates the CSP that other pages enforce (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'). The page also loads assets/pick-safety.js via external src, which is allowed, but the inline block would be blocked if CSP were present. Flagged as warning, not silently fixed in this session per non-overlap pledge (owner of build_origination.py should move handler to assets/origination.css or assets/scout.js).
